## Goal
Run the STACK data field as a one-field full-screen page inside Garmin's native Run activity.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Builds for `fr265`
- [ ] Renders at 416×416
- [ ] Shows current HR
- [ ] Uses Garmin running HR thresholds
- [ ] Highlights active zone
- [ ] Shows pace, distance, elapsed time
- [ ] FIT simulation tested
- [ ] Sideloaded to physical watch
